items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: The interviewee only repeats the interviewer's description ('Fair as a lily') and does not provide any personal anecdote or relationship context regarding Poikins.

ctx.x: So was Dave Perkins. Married a white girl though. Perkins was fair. Married a white girl. Poikins was fair as a lily and had blue eyes and blonde hair. He had colored blood.
